title: Gamma-prime instance segmentation in Ni-based superalloy microstructures: supporting data and code
description: Supporting micrographs, COCO annotations, fixed train/validation splits, evaluation results, figures and executable code for a one-class gamma-prime instance-segmentation workflow using Detectron2 Mask R-CNN.
notes: Before publication: add all co-authors/affiliations/ORCIDs/funding, confirm licences, add model_best_ap50.pth and optionally model_final.pth.
